name: Ultra Brands Ltd.
summary: Ultra Brands Ltd. functions as a holding company within the agricultural and food industries. The firm specializes in offering a variety of plant-based protein products, such as chicken tenders, nuggets, pork cutlets, and beef burgers. Established in 2001, the company was formerly known as Feel Foods Ltd. before rebranding to Ultra Brands Ltd. in May 2022. Its corporate headquarters are located in Vancouver, Canada.
